name: Volteruno – AI Blog Auto-Publish
author: András Vargyas

sections.description:
Volteruno writes high-quality, SEO-optimized blog articles for your business and publishes them straight to your WordPress site — fully automatically.

This plugin is the official connector between your WordPress site and your Volteruno account. After a one-click connection, Volteruno can publish AI-generated articles (with featured images, tags, categories, internal links and SEO metadata) directly to your blog.

What you get

  • AI-written, ready-to-publish blog posts in 25 languages
  • Automatic featured images
  • Internal linking, tags, categories and SEO meta
  • Scheduled or instant publishing
  • Full editorial control — preview and edit anything before it goes live

Why use this plugin

Instead of pasting credentials manually, the plugin creates a secure WordPress Application Password for the connection. You can disconnect at any time with one click — the password is automatically revoked.

Account required

This plugin requires a free Volteruno account. A free trial is available; paid plans unlock more articles per month.

External services

This plugin connects your WordPress site to Volteruno, a third-party SaaS service operated by Volteruno (https://volteruno.com), so AI-written blog posts created in your Volteruno dashboard can be published to your site automatically.

What is sent and when:

  • On connection (only when you click “Save & Connect”): the plugin sends your site URL, the connecting admin’s email/username, the Connection Code you pasted, and a freshly generated WordPress Application Password (named “Volteruno Auto-Publish”) to the Volteruno API endpoint at https://iaifmquygwpugdhrqmpr.supabase.co/functions/v1/wordpress-connect. This is required so Volteruno can authenticate future publishing requests to your site.
  • On publishing (only when you trigger a publish from the Volteruno dashboard): Volteruno sends the post content (title, body, featured image, tags, categories, excerpt, SEO metadata) back to your site via the standard WordPress REST API.

No data is sent to Volteruno unless you explicitly install this plugin, paste a Connection Code and click Save & Connect. The plugin does not send any analytics or telemetry.

The Volteruno backend is hosted on Supabase infrastructure, which is why the API endpoint above is on a supabase.co subdomain.

  • Service: Volteruno — https://volteruno.com
  • Terms of Service: https://volteruno.com/terms
  • Privacy Policy: https://volteruno.com/privacy

Privacy

This plugin sends your site URL, the connecting admin’s email/username and an auto-generated WordPress Application Password to the Volteruno API (https://volteruno.com) once, when you click Save & Connect. After that, the Volteruno service uses those credentials to publish articles you create in your Volteruno dashboard. No analytics or tracking data is collected by the plugin itself. See the Volteruno Privacy Policy for full details.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Go to Settings → Volteruno in your WordPress admin.
  3. Open your Volteruno dashboard → Integrations and copy the Connection Code for your site.
  4. Paste the code into the plugin settings page and click Save & Connect. Done!
sections.faq:
Do I need a paid Volteruno account?

No — you can start with a free account. Paid plans simply give you more articles per month.

Where do I find my Connection Code?

Log in to volteruno.com, open Integrations, add your WordPress site, and copy the code shown on the site card.

Is the connection secure?

Yes. The plugin creates a dedicated WordPress Application Password (named “Volteruno Auto-Publish”) so your real admin password is never shared. You can revoke access at any time by clicking Disconnect, or by deleting the Application Password from your WordPress profile.

What data is sent to Volteruno?

When you connect: your site URL, your admin email/username, and the auto-generated Application Password — so Volteruno can publish posts on your behalf. After that, only the article content you choose to publish is sent. Read more in our Privacy Policy.

Will it modify my existing posts?

No. The plugin only creates new posts via the standard WordPress REST API. It never edits or deletes existing content.

How do I disconnect?

Open Settings → Volteruno and click Disconnect, or simply deactivate the plugin. The Application Password is removed automatically.

screenshots.caption: Find it in WordPress. Search "volteruno" in Plugins → Add New and click Install Now. No ZIP upload, no FTP.
Activate in one click. Hit Activate — the Volteruno Connector menu appears under Settings instantly.
Paste your Connection Code. Grab the code from your Volteruno dashboard, paste it in, click Save & Connect.
Connected and ready. Green check confirms your site is live-linked to Volteruno and ready to receive AI articles.
Real article, real SEO. Featured image, table of contents, key takeaways, meta description — published automatically, ready to rank.
